title: feat(objectql): one package-scoped resolver for behavioural metadata and a shared declared-closure helper (ADR-0150 D3/D4)
body:
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XU6SjEqQ4aAk9NdivD3NcoK)_ epic:#31527#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5ovAHLWY1qohbSBYdw Fixes #31575 Refs #31527 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：新增一个共享解析器 `resolvePackageScopedName`，按 ADR-0150 D3 回答「这个裸名字指哪个软件包的元数据」：先调用方自己的包，再它声明的依赖闭包（加 `sys`）里唯一的持有者，否则拒绝并列出全部候选；无包调用方先环境项，再全环境唯一持有者，否则拒绝。依赖闭包抽成一个导出函数 `packageDependencyClosure`，保存门（`resolveWritePackageScope`）改用它，两边永不分歧。注册表新增三个只读方法，实现 D4 的「按包绑定覆盖层」：覆盖层只绑定到它定制的那个包的同名项。 - 为什么改：专题 #31527 的第 2 步 R；后续 E、G、S 各读者都只引用这一个解析器，避免各门各写一套规则再漂移。 - 风险与回滚：纯新增。没有任何读者接入，`getItem` 一行未动，阶段一的单持有者拒绝照旧生效，保存门的判定不变（metadata-protocol 全量测试 22591 条全绿）。回滚即还原本 PR。 - 先看：`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-resolver.ts` 的 `resolvePackageScopedName`（三步与拒绝）；`registry.ts` 的 `overlaySlotBinding`（覆盖层绑定规则）；`protocol-write-package-scope.ts` 的 `packageDependencyClosure`。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-resolver.test.ts`，预期 33 条全绿，含两条红线负向 pin 与阶段一一致性。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地（须在 ADR-0150 #31586 由你合并之后）。 ## What changes **`@objectstack/objectql` — `src/package-scoped-resolver.ts` (new), exported from the package barrel only.** - `resolvePackageScopedName(registry, { type, name, callerPackageId?, member? })`, ADR-0150 D3 exactly: - caller of package P: (1) P's own item (its overlay when one binds to it, else its composite slot); (2) else the unique holder in P's declared dependency closure plus every `sys`-namespace package; (3) else `refused`, naming every candidate. - caller with no package (`undefined`, `null`, `''` or the `sys_metadata` sentinel): the environment's own item, else the unique package holder, else `refused` naming every holder. - zero holders: `not-found`, never a refusal. - `PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES_BY_TYPE` (`permission` → `guest_portal`, the same list as the CLI's `PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES`, keyed by registry type): environment-wide whatever the caller, one holder. - `PACKAGE_SCOPED_TYPES`: D1 buckets 2 and 3 as the registry spells them (24 types). `position` (D7, Q2) and every bucket-1 type are not in it, and asking for one throws a `TypeError`. - An overridable baseline (`OVERRIDABLE_BASELINE_PACKAGES`, the email service's built-in templates) yields to any other candidate of the same step and answers only when it is the only one, which is how `bare-name-one-holder.ts` already reads it ("neither holds a name nor is refused one"). - The refusal is a value, not a throw: `{ status: 'refused', reason, type, name, callerPackageId, candidates, message }`. `reason` is `ambiguous-in-closure`, `ambiguous-in-environment` or `outside-closure`. `candidates` reuse the vocabulary's `BareNameHolder` (`kind: 'package'`) plus one kind this rule needs, `{ kind: 'environment' }`; `message` names each with `describeBareNameHolder`. The doors (child G) map it to `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`; nothing is minted here. - `packageResolutionClosure(registry, P)`: the save door's closure plus `sys`, exported so a reader can show what P reaches. - Not on the lean `./core` entry: the module reads `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, which ADR-0076 D2 keeps out of it (built `core.d.ts` carries 0 hits of `resolvePackageScopedName`; `index.d.ts` carries the export). **`@objectstack/objectql` — `src/registry.ts`, three read-only `SchemaRegistry` methods (ADR-0150 D4 row "registry overlay slot").** - `packageScopedHoldersOf(type, name)`: every package holding the name, in store order: each composite `PACKAGE:NAME` slot (read off the KEY, as `getItem`'s prefer-local reads it), then the package a bare-slot entry is its own stored item of. - `getPackageScopedItem(type, name, packageId, member?)`: the bare-slot entry when it binds to `packageId`, else that package's composite slot. Never another package's overlay, never the environment's item. - `getEnvironmentScopedItem(type, name, member?)`: the bare-slot entry when it binds to no package. - The binding rule (`overlaySlotBinding`), on the entry's `_packageId` (the stored row's `package_id` column, or the artifact envelope the hydration grafted, ADR-0010 §3.3): - package-less (none, `''` or the `sys_metadata` sentinel) and no package holds the name: the environment's own item (bucket 4); - package-less and exactly one package holds the name: that holder's overlay. This is ADR-0150 D3's "a package-less row that bears a package-held name is a customization, never a second item", read at call time, so a package installed later makes the row its overlay; - package-less and two or more packages hold the name: bound to none, and no environment item either (never a guess about whose customization it is); - a composite holder: its overlay; a `BASE.custom` pair whose base is a composite holder: the base's overlay (ADR-0146 D9); any other package: its own stored item. - The registry still stores one bare slot per name and `getItem` still serves it first to every caller; the per-package slot is how these new reads bind it. Bundles (`email_template`) bind per member. **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` — `src/protocol-write-package-scope.ts`.** - `packageDependencyClosure(packageId, registry)`: the walk (`resolvePackageClosure`, shared with Studio's pickers) plus the App-pair widening, exactly the body `resolveWritePackageScope` had. `resolveWritePackageScope` is now that call inside its existing silent `catch`. Exported from the package root. **Tests.** `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-resolver.test.ts` (new, 33 cases), and one census row in `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` (see Acceptance notes). **Changeset.** `.changeset/31575-package-scoped-resolver.md`: `patch` for both packages. ## Tests On head 87d197eb (after the one `origin/main` merge) unless a line says otherwise: - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-resolver.test.ts`: 33/33. The blocks: D3 with a caller package (7), D3 with no caller (5), red line 1 (2), red line 2 (3), D3 exceptions (4), the closure is the save door's (1), D4 overlay slot (6), phase-1 parity (5). - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 571/571 files, 11604/11604 tests, exit 0 (the lock's `VERDICT command-exit 0`). - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` (head 54ec46b4; no `packages/metadata-protocol` file changed after it, and the merged `origin/main` commits touch none): 327 files passed, 4 skipped; 22591 tests passed, 26 skipped; exit 0. This is the save door's unchanged behaviour: `protocol.package-closure-gate`, `protocol-publish-drafts-closure`, `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate`, `protocol.packaged-base-refusal` and the pair-widening suites all run through the switched `resolveWritePackageScope`. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck` (same head): exit 0. - `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the seven touched source and test files: exit 0.
Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs: mutation proven on disk, run, restored to the HEAD blob with git diff HEAD empty) The subject is imported from `src/` (relative import in the test), so no `dist/` rebuild is in the path. | # | Red line | Mutation | Red output | |:--|:--|:--|:--| | A1 | 1 | closure with two candidates answers the first-registered one instead of refusing | `× two holders in the closure refuse: no first-registered pick, even with a package-less row beside them`, `× in the closure: all three holders, in store order, each in the sentence`; `AssertionError: expected 'resolved' to be 'refused'`; 2 failed / 31 passed | | A2 | 1 | environment with two holders answers the first-registered one | `× two package holders refuse a caller with no package: no first-registered pick`, `× in the environment: all three holders…`, `× a platform-requested name…`, `× a package-less row over a name two packages hold binds to neither…`, `× a row bound to a package that ships no item…`; 5 failed / 28 passed | | A3 | 1 | nothing in the closure falls back to an environment-wide resolution | `× a caller package the registry cannot produce declares nothing…`, `× refuses, naming the holder, when the name is held only outside the closure — never an environment-wide guess`, `× a platform-requested name…`; 3 failed / 30 passed | | A4 | 2 | a refusal keeps only its first two candidates | `× in the closure: all three holders…`, `× in the environment: all three holders…`; `expected [ …(1) ] to deeply equal [ …(2) ]`; 2 failed / 31 passed | | A5 | D4 | `getPackageScopedItem` takes the bare slot whatever it binds to (today's `getItem` reading) | `× an overlay of one package's item never shadows another package's same-named item`, `× a package-less row over a name two packages hold binds to neither…`, `× a row bound to a package that ships no item…`; 3 failed / 30 passed | | A6 | D3 (newer text) | every package-less row is the environment's own item, whoever holds the name | `× a package-less row under the one holder's name is that holder's overlay, never a second item`, `× a package-less row is the environment's own item only while no package holds the name`, `× a package-less row over a name two packages hold…`, `× every covered type, one package holder and a package-less row over its name: the same item…`; 4 failed / 29 passed | The readings above are the final code's (head after the ADR re-read). An earlier round on the first head read the same reds; its A3 first attempt kept the anchor inside its replacement and was refused by the tool before running (a no-op, not a reading), then re-run with a rewriting anchor.
## Acceptance notes **ADR-0150 Execution plan, readings (a)–(d).** - **(a) phase-1 one-holder tests stay green.** `registry-bare-name-one-holder.test.ts` and its request, flow and AI family files run in the full objectql suite above. The new test's last case also pins that a second package holder is still refused once sealed. - **(b) bare-name behaviour unchanged.** No reader imports the resolver: `git grep package-scoped-resolver -- packages ui` answers only the module, its test, the barrel and one comment in `registry.ts`. `getItem` has no diff. The phase-1 parity block asserts, for all 11 covered registry types, under a sealed registry, with and without an overlay of the one holder, for a caller with no package, the holder itself and a dependent, that the resolver's item IS `getItem`'s item (`toBe`), and the same for an environment-only item. - **(c) migration.** None in this PR: no stored shape, no column, no backfill. - **(d) declarations.** `Clause-②: no`: the diff adds TypeScript exports to two published packages (`@objectstack/objectql` `index.d.ts`; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `index.d.ts`, `packageDependencyClosure`) and changes no spec schema, protocol, SDK, door request or response. `Metadata-protocol: none`: no authorable value is accepted or refused differently. ADR-0087: no migration entry owed (nothing stored or authored changes). **Red lines 1 and 2.** Pinned by the `red line` blocks and ablated (A1–A4 above). Every refusal carries every candidate of the step that refused; `outside-closure` carries every holder there is plus the environment when it holds one. **Readings this PR had to make where ADR-0150 is silent (named for the seat's review).** 1. **ADR re-read.** ADR-0150's head moved to 565c63c2 while this was built. Its new D3 paragraph ("a package-less row that bears a package-held name is a customization, never a second item") changed the binding rule; this PR follows it (commit "a package-less row over a package-held name binds to that holder"), and A6 pins it. The rest of D3 and D4 is unchanged; the R row now says the resolver adds `sys` itself, which it does. 2. A caller with a package whose name only the environment's own item holds is refused, naming the environment (`outside-closure`), not served it and not answered not-found. D3 lists the environment item only for a caller with no package. This is the only reading that neither loosens nor hides a holder; it is in the report's `open_questions` with the four axes. 3. A package-less row over a name two packages hold binds to neither (the newer D3 text speaks of "that one phase-1 holder"; for an uncovered type with two holders, picking one would be a guess). The environment-wide answer is then the refusal naming both. Today the hydration grafts the first holder's envelope onto such a row (`_packageId`), so it reads as that holder's overlay here, exactly as the bare slot already serves it; this PR does not change the hydration. 4. A bare-slot row bound to a package that ships no item of the name counts as that package's own stored item, so with another package's shipped item the environment-wide answer is a refusal. Phase 1's holder set never reads the bare slot; the ADR identity (`sys_metadata` unique on package) does. Pinned by the D4 block. 5. Disabled packages are not filtered, as `getItem` does not filter them. 6. `rag_pipeline` (D1 bucket 3) has no registry type since ADR-0049 retired the collection, so the type list has 24 entries. 7. An object-bound action is resolved by the registry's `(action, name)` key only; `(package, objectName, name)` is child E2's key. **Census row.** `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` scans every string literal in `src/` that equals an injected column name. The type list's `'queue'` (the metadata type, ADR-0150 D1) matched the ADR-0142 ownership-queue column; the row records it as `not-a-read`, as the same file already does for `registry.ts`'s and `assignment-rules.ts`'s `queue`. **Two copies of the platform-requested list.** `PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES_BY_TYPE` here and the CLI's `PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES` (keyed by collection) hold the same one name. objectql cannot import the CLI, and the CLI file is outside this card's surface. Child P (which retires the CLI's phase-2 finding) is the natural place to make the CLI read objectql's. class: observation · carrier: #31527 child P. ## Verification - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on head 87d197eb: 71 families derived; each run with its exit captured before any pipe: **71 exit 0**. `--ran` reconciliation: "71 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". - On the first head (a0b690f7) `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` answered exit 3 (shallow clone, its fixture commit missing) and passed after `git fetch --depth=1` of that commit; on 87d197eb it ran green in the loop. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered exit 3 (prerequisite) on the first head and exit 0 on 87d197eb ("122 published require entry point(s) across 72 package(s) load"). - Built entries: `packages/objectql/dist/index.d.ts` carries `resolvePackageScopedName` (2 hits), `dist/core.d.ts` carries none; `packages/metadata-protocol/dist/index.d.ts` carries `packageDependencyClosure`. - Not run locally, owned by CI: `test:repo` (no file of that project changed), the full lint farm, dogfood (no `!` in the title, no narrowing arm). - Record: `pm-orders/epic-31527/31575-gates-ran.txt` in the project files. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01FEkQ5ovAHLWY1qohbSBYdw)_
